title: LighterWise Server
description: A server for the LighterWise community!
body:
# LighterWise Server 🧡🔦
The LighterWise server is a server for the LighterWise & Zenless Zone Zero community!

This server is a way for everyone in our community to hang out and have a nice time together! If your a fan of Zenless Zone Zero or LighterWise, consider joining our [Discord](https://discord.gg/lighterwise) & server! Server access can be gained by linking your Discord account to your Minecraft account on the Discord.

## Gameplay 🎮
Any and all changes to the world or modpack will be decided on by everyone in the Discord!
